sections.title: Art & Culture in Italy: Rome, Siena & Florence
sections.subtitle: Introduction
sections.html:
Art & Culture in Italy: Rome, Siena & Florence

Explore the masterpieces of the Renaissance, meet contemporary artisans, and create your own art in inspiring Italian settings. This sample itinerary blends guided cultural visits, hands-on creative workshops, local cuisine, and time to enjoy each destination.

sections.title: Day 1 - Welcome to Rome
sections.html:
Arrival in Rome

Arrive in Rome and transfer to your centrally located hotel.

Orientation walk through historic piazzas

Enjoy an orientation walk through historic piazzas.

Welcome dinner featuring Roman specialties

Welcome dinner featuring Roman specialties.

sections.title: Day 2 - Ancient Rome and the Art of the City
sections.html:
Colosseum and Roman Forum guided visit

Discover the Colosseum and Roman Forum with a local guide.

Explore Rome’s historic center

Continue through Rome’s historic center to admire its architecture, fountains, and public sculpture.

Optional sketching session in a piazza

Optional sketching session in a picturesque piazza.

sections.title: Day 3 - Vatican Masterpieces and Creative Rome
sections.html:
Visit the Vatican Museums and Sistine Chapel

Visit the Vatican Museums and Sistine Chapel with a specialist guide, subject to reservations.

Explore St. Peter’s Basilica

Explore St. Peter’s Basilica when accessible.

Private drawing or watercolor workshop

Join a private drawing or watercolor workshop led by a local artist, or reserve time for a workshop led by your group’s own instructor.

sections.title: Day 4 - Artisans, Food, and the Roman Lifestyle
sections.html:
Meet artisans in a working studio

Meet artisans in a working studio for a behind-the-scenes visit and a hands-on mosaic-making experience.

Food-focused walk or cooking class

Enjoy a food-focused walk or cooking class featuring regional ingredients.

Free evening to explore Rome

Free evening to explore Rome.

sections.title: Day 5 - Through Tuscany to Siena
sections.html:
Travel by private coach through the Tuscan countryside to Siena

Travel by private coach through the Tuscan countryside to Siena.

Explore the medieval streets and Piazza del Campo

Explore the medieval streets and Piazza del Campo.

Visit Siena Cathedral

Visit Siena Cathedral, renowned for its decorative art and architecture.

Overnight in Siena or the surrounding countryside

Overnight in Siena or the surrounding countryside.

sections.title: Day 6 - Siena and a Tuscan Creative Workshop
sections.html:
Guided visit to Siena museum or historic site

Discover Siena’s artistic heritage, including works of the Sienese school, during a guided visit to a local museum or historic site.

Tuscan traditions creative workshop

Take part in a workshop inspired by Tuscan traditions, such as painting, ceramics, or decorative techniques.

Relaxed regional dinner

Enjoy a relaxed regional dinner.

sections.title: Day 7 - Florence: The Renaissance Comes Alive
sections.html:
Continue to Florence

Continue to Florence.

Guided walking tour of Florence

Take a guided walking tour featuring the Duomo complex, Piazza della Signoria, and Ponte Vecchio.

Visit the Accademia Gallery

Visit the Accademia Gallery to see Michelangelo’s David, subject to availability.

Evening at leisure

Enjoy an evening at leisure.

sections.title: Day 8 - Florence: Great Art and Hands-On Creation
sections.html:
Visit the Uffizi Gallery

Visit the Uffizi Gallery with an art-focused guide, subject to advance booking.

Meet a Florentine artisan or take part in a workshop

Meet a Florentine artisan in a studio or take part in a fresco, marbling, or painting workshop.

Farewell dinner

A farewell dinner celebrates the group’s creative journey.

sections.title: Day 9 - Arrivederci, Italia!
sections.html:
Breakfast

Breakfast and transfer to Florence Airport for individual departures, or extend the journey with additional time in Tuscany.

Transfer to Florence Airport

Transfer to Florence Airport for individual departures, or extend the journey with additional time in Tuscany.
